hardware.formal_comparison_hardware_match: same A100-SXM4-40GB, SM80, Torch and CUDA runtime; physical GPU UUID recorded for provenance only

scopes.sampler: synchronized real five-NFE sampler wall interval; runtime memory includes resident tokenizer and endpoint setup temporaries
scopes.dit_replay: five DiT forwards from fixed BF16-captured network inputs; generic CUDA graph replay and CUDA-event timing; only DiT-required modules resident on GPU

speedup: paired-scope BF16 mean divided by method mean; median ratio also reported separately
peak: maximum allocated bytes across matched measurements divided by 1e9; no subtraction of arbitrary resident bytes
storage: unique whole-DiT inference tensor payload bytes divided by 2^30, including backend padding and scales, transforms and unquantized DiT weights; excludes workspace and file-container overhead

gates.native_normalized_motor_definition: RMS difference divided by reference RMS, first six motor dimensions only; gripper excluded from denominator and full-action maxabs also recorded

publication_boundary: Native performance measurements; baseline numerical differences and incomplete/failed fidelity panels are reported rather than treated as pass. Existing closed-loop scores belong only to prior decoded-reference execution. No new training or closed-loop.
